info.title: Calibration Ledger — trust a forecast, with evidence (beta)
info.description:
Score IMF, OECD, Fed, SPF and issuer claims vs outcomes — bands, bias, misses, or honest no coverage.

More: https://apify.com/publicrecords/calibration-ledger

mode.title: Mode
x-enumTitles: Lookup: a live number by source/series/geo/period
Score: a source's record on a series
Compare: rank sources on one question
Coverage: what the ledger can answer
Verify: provenance of a claim id
mode.description: text = hand it a sentence ("The IMF expects Canada's economy to grow 1.8% in 2027"). lookup/score/compare use structured fields.

claim_text.title: Claim (text mode)
claim_text.description: Free-text claim for text mode (e.g. "The IMF expects Canada's economy to grow 1.8% in 2027").

source.title: Source organization
source.description: imf_weo | oecd_eo | fed_sep | spf | ecb_spf | pbo, or an issuer name; optional in text mode

series.title: Series
series.description: Generated from rules.yaml — every series the ledger resolves.

geo.title: Geography (ISO3 / EA / USA)
geo.description: ISO3 country code, EA, or USA. Required for most score/lookup/compare calls.

target_period.title: Target period (YYYY, YYYYQn, YYYY-MM)
target_period.description: Target period as YYYY, YYYYQn, or YYYY-MM when looking up a specific claim.

point.title: Claimed value
point.description: Numeric claimed value for lookup mode (string so decimals stay exact).

published_at.title: Claim date (YYYY-MM-DD)
published_at.description: When the claim was published (YYYY-MM-DD), for lookup/verify.

horizon_bucket.title: Horizon bucket
horizon_bucket.description: Optional horizon bucket filter for score mode.

band_kind.title: Band kind (score mode)
band_kind.description: For Fed SEP score mode: central_tendency or range.

claim_id.title: Claim id (verify mode)
claim_id.description: Ledger claim id for verify mode.

issuer.title: Issuer (issuer mode)
issuer.description: Organization name as it appears on its releases/filings (e.g. Salesforce Inc). Both records are returned: dated promises (newswires) and numeric guidance (EDGAR).

post.summary: Run Calibration Ledger — trust a forecast, with evidence (beta)
post.description: Runs the job and returns the result rows as JSON (waits up to 280 s).
